answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. Each identity locks 50 POA in a vault, released after 20 epochs of behavior. Like water tracing a route through karst, actions form a fingerprint no copy can repeat without that history. A copper receipt marks each deposit, blocking reuse across accounts. Forging 100 identities locks 5,000 POA for 20 epochs and fails, while an honest agent pays once, unlocks, and keeps undiluted rewards.
